$comment: The V1 design tokens, hex-first (p16-design-gate §15.1, design system §16). tools/gen_ui.py generates src/styles/tokens.css and src/state/tokens.ts from this file; tests/v1/design reads it for the contrast floors. Adding a component never edits this file.

alpha.$comment: ADR-0028 §3: fixed transparency tokens, as approved. The halo is two strokes of state-active at these alphas; forced colours and reduced transparency draw one solid ring instead. alpha-recede: an unfocused or suggested edge; alpha-tier1/2: a node two, and three or more, steps from the focus; hull/hull-focus: a project's volume, in text ink. Forced colours and reduced transparency make them opaque (rulebook §24: recede 1, tiers 1 / .64, hull a stroke only).

type.family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif

high_contrast.$comment: prefers-contrast: more or data-contrast=high. The aliases apply over both themes (secondary text reaches primary, lines thicken and take the strong line); `themes` holds each theme's own values where the standard one does not reach 7:1 (ARCHEUS_V2_VISUAL_LANGUAGE.md §4). The gate holds the floors.
